svg.aria-label: Highlights as a transit map. One line runs through four technology waves: automation and RPA at TCS (2011) and Deloitte (2014); analytics and optimisation at an airline (2019) and RPost (2021); ML in production at Sabre (2022) and RateGain (2023); LLM agents at DevRev (2026, now), as Forward Deployed Engineer and AI Solution Architect. A train runs the line on a loop, lighting each station, then trains leave DevRev on five coloured lines to production-grade results. Airline: 21 skills, 14 states, one orchestrator that runs customer ops end to end. Banking: 0 fabrications across thousands of transactions; every finding cites its record; 46 of 50 adversarial QA cases passed. Fintech: one platform for IT, HR, finance and promo. Consumer goods: 4 AI workflows. Automotive: LightGBM demand forecasting. Side lines: founded Legit.ai in 2025, legal AI on Claude, OpenAI, Perplexity and own models; spoke on 'Who Owns the Outcome?'.
